name: bilibili_run
description: Extract a Bilibili video's text into a timestamped document on Cocoonbox, using captions or remote PaddleOCR-VL-1.6-GGUF image recognition. Sampled JPEG frames go to the configured OCR server; there is no CPU fallback. Call with code: "", screenshot: false, params: {bilibili_link: "https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV…/"}. This starts a background job and returns job_id. Then call code: "", screenshot: false, params: {action: "status", job_id: "…"}; when completed call params: {action: "document", job_id: "…"} to receive the document text and saved Markdown/HTML paths. Poll at sensible intervals; a full video can take many minutes. If next_offset is non-null, retrieve the next document chunk using offset: next_offset; never present a truncated chunk as the full document. mode: auto (default, accessible captions then OCR), ocr (visible text), captions (caption track only). OCR options: region full (default) or subtitles (bottom 38%); interval_seconds 2 (default), 1, 3, 5, or 10. OCR is sampled and may contain errors; it is not audio transcription. Handles one video part at a time, up to four hours and 2 GiB. Existing jobs are reused; retry: true restarts a failed job. Report failed status and error faithfully. No arbitrary code is executed by this tool. The source's license is not established by this tool.

resources.description: Bilibili extraction: start a caption or remote OCR job, check progress, and retrieve the resulting document
